name: Food-101
description: Food-101 is an image classification dataset containing 101 food categories, with 1,000 images per category (101,000 images total).
citation: Bossard, L., Guillaumin, M., & Van Gool, L. (2014). Food-101 – Mining Discriminative Components with Random Forests. European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV). https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-319-10599-4_29
